The first release of Pişti: a self-hosted two-player card game for good company.

- Play against Ada or invite a friend to a private table with a link or QR code.
- Standard captures, 10-point Pişti, 20-point jack Pişti, and a 101-point match target.
- English and Turkish, light/dark/system themes, and a responsive installable client.
- Authoritative Go server, private hands, signed seat restoration, and automatic reconnection.
- Scores, last capture, round results, and move history remain available on phones.

Docker images support Linux amd64 and arm64:

```sh
docker pull ghcr.io/abdusco/pisti:v1.0.0
docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 ghcr.io/abdusco/pisti:v1.0.0
```

Also tagged as `1.0.0` and `latest`. Tables are held in memory and reset when the server restarts. Use HTTPS and a reverse proxy with WebSocket upgrades for installation on phones.
